cause: Releases are recorded as shipped without checking that the store actually published them, so fixes and notes reach members late or not at all.
guard: A post-release check that reads the store track's live version and fails the release run if it does not match.

cause: The under-18 stop only blocks new saving; it does not remove what is already stored or update the status line.
guard: The under-18 stop runs one shared routine that deletes server copies and updates every status, with a test.

cause: Failures are caught and either shown as 'try again' or kept only on the device, with no shared reporter that writes a log line and sends it to MettleUp, so breakage is invisible until a gym complains.
guard: One shared report-failure helper (log line plus send to the HQ error view) and a lint rule that fails the build on any catch block that does not call it.

cause: When a read fails, the code falls back to a default (empty, zero, none, all clear, paid, not demo) that looks like a true answer, so screens and decisions act on a guess.
guard: Reads return an explicit 'could not read' state every caller must handle; a lint rule bans catch blocks that return an empty or default value, plus a test per reader that forces the failure.

cause: The same number (counts, records, kg, weeks, money) is worked out by separate rules in different places, so screens disagree.
guard: One shared function per shown number and a cloud test that checks the number is the same everywhere it appears.

cause: Automatic jobs, senders and outside services (WhatsApp, AI, payment keys, backup) have no heartbeat the outage alarm checks, and some health checks answer 'fine' when they cannot read, so a stopped job goes unnoticed.
guard: Every job and outside service writes a heartbeat; the outage alarm runs on time, checks each heartbeat and fails loud on unreadable state, with a test that stops each one.

cause: There is no single rule for whether a member can get an app pop-up, so send screens say 'sent' or 'members see it' without checking who will really get it.
guard: One shared 'can this member be reached, and how' rule used by every send screen, which lists who will not get it and offers WhatsApp instead.

cause: An action fails and the user is shown nothing, or is told it worked, because the failure path has no message.
guard: Every user action's failure path must show a message; a shared action wrapper does this and a test forces each action to fail.

cause: Writes carry no once-only request id and taps are not guarded, so a retry after a lost answer, or a double tap, saves twice or is misread as a new or bad request.
guard: Every write sends a once-only request id that the server stores and replays, and a shared test retries each write after a dropped answer.

cause: Pending items (requests, leads, prizes, stuck payments, questions) close only through their own button, so the same thing done another way leaves them open.
guard: Pending items are closed by matching the underlying event (payment, member, gift, reply, signup), with a test doing each by the other route.

cause: Screens poll on fixed short timers with no back-off or stop, and static files go through the worker, using up the shared free request limit.
guard: A shared poll helper that backs off and stops when idle or hidden, and a request budget per screen measured in CI.

cause: Server data grows with no per-gym size budget and no scheduled cleanup, so one gym or old data can fill the free database or store.
guard: A per-gym storage budget and a nightly cleanup job for each growing table, with a size check in CI.

cause: 'Stopped coming' counting ignores freezes, approved pauses, closed days and a new plan start, and is written by more than one rule.
guard: One shared absence rule that subtracts pauses and closed days and restarts at a new plan, used everywhere, with tests.

cause: Browser and phone stores have no size budget or early warning, so a full device silently drops data.
guard: One device-storage budget helper that warns early and never drops queued records without telling the user.

cause: Free-tier and paid limits have no early warning to MettleUp, so the first sign is a failure.
guard: One limits table watched daily with an HQ Needs-you alarm at 70 percent of each limit.

cause: New rules apply only to new records, with no backfill for existing members or data.
guard: Every rule change ships with a backfill step and a check that old records meet the new rule.

cause: People are matched by names, first words or per-sign-in accounts instead of one stable key, so the same person becomes two records or loses data.
guard: One shared person-matching rule (normalised mobile, then account link) used by every join, import, lead and chat path.

cause: Personal training packs are stored as membership plans and not linked to trainers, so plan readers count them and trainers never hear of them.
guard: Give PT packs their own type, excluded by the shared plan reader and linked to the trainer, with a test.

cause: The nightly backup is not sized for growth, misses some tables and has never been restored for real.
guard: A scheduled real restore drill that checks every table and reports backup size against the store limit.

cause: Jobs and lists work only on a fixed recent window, so items older than it, including ones missed during an outage, quietly vanish.
guard: Jobs process by 'not yet done' state, not by age window, with a test that runs after a long outage.

cause: Privacy and legal words were written without checking where data really goes (backups, uploads, payment store), so they promise more than is true.
guard: A data-flow list that every privacy sentence is checked against before release.

cause: Public or anonymous paths have no per-caller or total cap, or their cap switches off quietly when its store fails.
guard: Every public path has a rate and total cap that fails closed, with a test per path.

cause: Screens ship before the server part they call exists live, so a missing server piece reads as 'switched off' or a feature that does nothing.
guard: A deploy check that every server function and table a screen calls exists on the live database before the screen can be switched on.

cause: Reminders and cards act on an old copy on the phone with no freshness check.
guard: Every read of a local copy checks its age and refreshes before acting on it.

cause: The assistant's add-member card does not recompute the joining fee when the plan changes.
guard: A test that changing the plan on the card recomputes every fee.

cause: Screen and help words are written once and not re-checked when the feature changes, so they promise or name things that are not true.
guard: Each promise sentence is tied to a behaviour test, and help and what's-new pages are checked against live switches before release.

cause: There is no dead-code check, so unused and switched-off code, some kept alive only by its own tests, piles up.
guard: A dead-code check in CI that fails on unused exports and on tests that guard only unused code.

cause: Many screens and services have no test that runs them, only tests that look for words in the code, so breakage goes unseen.
guard: A coverage gate that each screen and service has at least one test that renders or runs it, and a ban on source-text tests.

cause: Screens and saves recompute from the whole history on every open, tick or save instead of keeping running totals, and nothing times this against big data.
guard: A big-gym and five-year-member speed test in CI with a time budget per screen.

cause: Screens pick their error words from one catch-all guess instead of the real kind of failure, so a server fault, a shared limit or a full store is shown as 'no internet', 'switched off', 'you used too much' or a vague error.
guard: One shared error classifier (offline / server fault / shared limit / full store / refused with reason) that every screen uses for its message, with a test feeding each kind.

cause: Gym pause, unpaid lock, Pro and Plus locks and page-off are checked screen by screen, so new screens and server paths miss them.
guard: One server-side entitlement check that every read and write passes through, with a table test for each lock against each feature.

cause: Member choices (units, hidden exercises, machine steps, goals, snoozes, sharing) are read separately by each feature, so newer features miss them.
guard: One shared member-preferences reader and a test listing every feature that must honour each preference.

cause: The feature map and set-up notes are hand-kept, not read from live state, so they say things are off or waiting that are live.
guard: Generate the feature map from live switches and the live database, with a check that fails when they disagree.

cause: Each input box parses numbers, phones and text itself, so Hindi digits, 'Rs.', decimal points, +91 and spaces are handled differently or wrongly.
guard: One shared input reader for numbers, money, phones and codes used by every box, with one test table of awkward inputs.

cause: No product usage events are recorded anywhere central, so activation, day-30 use and feature uptake are unknown and some progress lives only in one browser.
guard: One shared usage-event helper writing to the server, with a required event list per feature that a check compares against the code.

cause: Small rules and helpers are copied by hand into several files and have drifted apart.
guard: A duplicate-code check in CI that fails when a known helper is written again.

cause: Database links and filters have no index and the database check never asks for index advice, so reads scan whole tables.
guard: Add the database index advisor to the database check and fail on any unindexed link or filter.

cause: Progress maths use fixed calendar windows and ignore the member's real training span (join date, partial weeks, long breaks, easy weeks).
guard: One shared training-span helper that every target, report and average uses, tested with a new member and one back after six weeks off.

cause: Sends keep no per-member delivery or seen record, so owners, HQ and MettleUp cannot see who got or read a message.
guard: A per-member delivery record written by every sender and shown on each send screen, with a test that a send leaves one.

cause: Ideas, nudges and cards do not read the shared record of what was already sent, automated or finished, so they offer the same action again.
guard: Every nudge reads one shared 'already done or automated' record before it shows, with a test per nudge.

cause: Greyed-out controls show no reason, because there is no shared disabled-with-reason control.
guard: A shared disabled control that requires a reason line, and a lint rule against bare disabled buttons.

cause: Seen marks, ticks, language and notes are kept in one browser or phone instead of on the server, so other devices disagree.
guard: Owner and member state lives on the server; a lint check bans local storage for anything but view conveniences.

cause: Sends are marked done when they are handed over, not when they really succeed, so failures are never retried and screens say 'sent' too early.
guard: A shared outbox rule: a send is marked done only on confirmed success, failed sends stay queued for retry, and screens show 'queued' until then; one test fails the provider and checks the retry.

cause: Owner settings (AI limits, trial, offers, language, message calm, alerts, defaults) are read separately by each feature or hard-coded, so some features ignore them.
guard: One shared gym-settings reader with defaults on the server, and a test listing every feature that must honour each setting.

cause: Pages ship as one big download with blocking fonts and late pictures, and nothing checks page speed on a phone.
guard: A page-speed check on a phone profile in CI with a size and layout-shift budget.

cause: Work the phone does in the background (closed-app set ticks, Health deletes, leave notes, ratings, late replies, record rebuilds) has no durable outbox, so one failure or a closed app loses it or delays it for hours.
guard: One durable phone outbox with retry and back-off for every background write, plus a test that kills the app mid-send and checks it lands later.

cause: Taps and links are pointed at screens by hand, and nothing checks they open the place their words name.
guard: A test that every notification, link and button target opens the screen its words name.

cause: Buttons and titles are fixed to one line, and no test renders them at big font on a narrow phone.
guard: Render every screen at the largest font on a narrow phone in CI and fail on cut-off or overflowing text.

cause: CI checks can show green while testing nothing (skipped, warn-only, re-run, never triggered).
guard: Every CI check must report how many things it tested and fail on zero, with no warn-only check left past a set date.

cause: Whether someone is new is guessed from install or join dates, so long-time members get new-member treatment and new ones get upgrade notes.
guard: One shared 'is this person new' rule based on account history, with tests for reinstall, phone change and fresh install.

cause: The app reads only its own switches, not the phone's notification, channel, Do Not Disturb or battery settings, so it says alerts are on when the phone blocks them.
guard: One shared 'can this phone ring' check reading permission, channel, DND and maker battery rules, used by every alert status row.

cause: Whether a plan has started, ended, been renewed or is still owed is worked out separately on each screen, so dues, renewals and endings disagree.
guard: One shared membership-status helper used by every tile, list, reminder and sheet, with tests for unstarted, cancelled and later renewals.

cause: Door machine commands and uploads are fire-and-forget with no acknowledged queue, so failed or unreadable ones are lost and lapsed members can keep entry.
guard: A door-machine queue where each command and upload is acknowledged, retried and shown to the owner when it fails, with a test that drops one.

cause: The watch keeps its own copies of phone settings and workout state with no sync rule, so switches and dedupe windows drift from the phone.
guard: The watch reads settings and rest state from one synced record on every use, with a test changing each setting on the phone.

cause: Edits and deletes on one side are not pushed to the copies held elsewhere (member app, gym mates, gym offer counts).
guard: Every edit or delete fires one shared change event that updates all copies, with a test that deletes and checks each copy.

cause: The desk's offline queue does not handle final refusals, cancels with no answer, or weak lines, and buttons are not greyed offline.
guard: One offline-queue state model (waiting, refused, cancelled) shown on every screen, with controls greyed when offline, and tests.

cause: Read marks, badges and tray pop-ups are set by side signals (background counts, pushes) rather than by the member actually opening the item.
guard: Opening an item is the one place that marks it read, clears its pop-up and updates the count, covered by one test.

cause: The owner's access list and the HQ log read a fixed list of actions, so new kinds of look or change are left out.
guard: Every HQ or direct look writes one shared access record and the owner list reads all kinds, with a test per kind.

cause: Some ways of adding a member never ask for fields that later features need (birthday, body figure).
guard: A list of fields each feature needs, checked against every add path.

cause: AI spend is counted in some places and not others, so the monthly cost is wrong.
guard: Every AI call goes through one helper that records its cost, including failed tries.

cause: Bulk work and page loads send requests one after another instead of in one batch.
guard: A shared batch-write helper and a test that a bulk action makes one request.

cause: Gym plan sync to the phone has no clear merge rule for deleted or edited folders, so trainer changes are lost or lead nowhere.
guard: A written merge rule for gym plans (trainer change wins and brings back deleted folders) with tests for delete, edit and pop-up tap.

cause: Lists stop at a fixed newest-N with no paging, so counts and older items are cut off.
guard: Every list either pages or says it is cut off, and counts come from the server, not the capped list.

cause: Outside calls are made with no time limit, so a stalled line leaves screens waiting for ever.
guard: One shared fetch helper with a default time limit, and a lint rule banning bare fetch calls.

cause: Terms acceptance is captured only once at join, never re-asked on change, not re-openable and not read by HQ.
guard: A terms version number checked on every sign-in, re-openable from settings and shown in HQ.

cause: Timed work (receipts, rest alarms, hold countdowns, quiet installs) runs only while a screen is open or the app is in front, so time promises are not kept.
guard: Timed work runs on a server schedule or an exact system alarm, never on an open screen, with a test that backgrounds the app before the time.

cause: Crash reporting covers only the JavaScript side and sends only when online, and its alert ignores repeats, so native and offline crashes are missed.
guard: Native crashes are queued offline and sent later, with an alert on returning or spreading crash kinds, checked by a forced test crash in CI.

cause: Demo workouts are not flagged in one place, so widgets, exports and counts treat them as real.
guard: Every reader filters through one 'real workouts only' helper, with a test that loads the demo.

cause: Linking a member found by number or invite to the gym list happens once and is not retried, so the member waits for a QR check-in.
guard: Linking runs as a retried job until confirmed, with a test that fails the first try.

cause: Restore, erase and sign-in do not cover every piece of member state, so some choices survive or are lost.
guard: One list of member state items that restore, erase and sign-in all use, with a test that round-trips each item.

cause: Branch-level and gym-level settings are not clearly scoped, so a change hits one branch only or a member is blocked at others.
guard: One rule per setting saying gym-wide or per branch, shown on the screen and tested.

cause: Cloud run setup is copied by hand into each run, so fixes and versions drift.
guard: One shared setup step that every run uses.

cause: GST is split only when a receipt is printed, never stored, so monthly totals and exports cannot show it.
guard: Store the GST split on each payment and read it in every money report.

cause: The pop-up sender sends a fixed number per minute, so big gyms wait and late pop-ups are dropped.
guard: Size the sender by queue length and alarm on late or dropped pop-ups.

cause: Automatic and system messages draw from the gym's own daily member-message cap.
guard: System messages get their own cap separate from the owner's.

cause: The app's update check and update notes read GitHub, not the store the member installed from.
guard: Update checks read the store the app came from.

cause: The body map lights the wrong shoulder heads for side raises.
guard: A test table of exercise-to-muscle lighting.

cause: Branding previews only the dark look.
guard: Preview both themes.

cause: Muscles ready today names one workout but shows another's sets.
guard: A test that the named workout and the shown sets match.

cause: The Strength score can fall with no explanation of why.
guard: Show the reason for every score change, with a test.

cause: A test message was left live in every gym's bell.
guard: Test sends go to a test gym only, enforced by HQ.

cause: A free plan still offers online pay of zero rupees.
guard: Hide online pay when the total is zero, with a test.

cause: The India-day and date rules are written out by hand in many places, some on the device or world clock.
guard: One shared India-date module and a lint rule banning raw date maths elsewhere.

cause: Tests wait on real time or read today's date, so they fail on slow machines or around midnight, or skip silently.
guard: A shared fake clock required in tests, with a lint rule banning real waits and real dates.

cause: Old ForgeAI assets and generic icons are still shipped, because no check lists the brand assets in use.
guard: An asset check that fails on old-brand names or images and on missing icon shapes.

cause: Long lists draw every row and pictures are drawn full size, with no virtualising or small previews.
guard: Shared list and picture parts that virtualise rows and use thumbnails, required by lint.

cause: One-time repairs and import markers depend on reads that can fail and leave no trace, so repairs rerun, fail silently or delay start-up.
guard: A shared one-time-job runner that records success durably, logs failure, never blocks start-up, and is tested by failing the marker read.

cause: Screens hold the processor or screen awake and redraw too often, and battery use is never measured.
guard: A battery and redraw budget measured in the watch and phone workout tests.

cause: A spoken request that fails still uses up speaking time.
guard: Charge speaking time only on success, with a test.

cause: The assistant's wallet check is not reset when the owner switches gym.
guard: Reset per-gym state on gym switch, with a test.

cause: Invite links have no iPhone path that keeps the gym.
guard: An invite-link test per platform.

cause: Raw request text is logged on parse errors, so personal data can land in the server log.
guard: A log scrubber on every server log line, with a test using a phone number.

cause: A background check forces sign-in when the session ends and throws away what was being typed.
guard: Session expiry keeps unsaved input and asks to sign in over the page.
